character: 老周（父亲）— 咬牙发力
description: Old Zhou (father), 56 years old. Same base description: dark blue work jacket, gray cotton trousers, stocky build with chronic back issues.
scene: The moment of lifting his daughter from bed to wheelchair. Peak physical exertion.
clothing: Dark blue work jacket (sleeves slightly rolled up), gray cotton trousers.
actions: Bending at the waist with arms extended under his daughter's armpits, both hands gripping fabric. Legs slightly bent. Entire torso and arm muscles visibly tensed. Veins prominent on forearms and neck.

angles.front: Face contorted with effort, teeth clenched showing, brow deeply furrowed. Sweat beginning at temples.
angles.side: Profile showing the dangerous arch of his lower back, arms fully extended upward, his spine bearing all the weight.
angles.three_quarter: From slightly above, emphasizing the awkward bending angle and the weight being lifted.

expression: Gritting teeth — jaw clenched, teeth visible, brow deeply furrowed. Veins visible on forehead. Pure physical exertion.
mood: Raw physical effort, silent determination, pain masked by willpower.
lighting: Directional warm light from side window, casting strong shadows on muscle tension lines.
note: This is the key image of Act I. It must convey strain without glorifying it.
